text: Pan Pan, Pan Pan, Pan Pan, Air France 4095, Boeing 737. We have shut down number two engine due to a bird strike. Heading now 320, altitude 600 metres, current position 10 miles south of Romeo Tango Delta. Request return for immediate landing. Why was the engine shut down?
